newsitem.title: USA: Fusion sees Q3 gain $6.60/shr on asset sale.
newsitem.headline: Fusion sees Q3 gain $6.60/shr on asset sale.

text.p: Fusion Systems Corp said on Monday that, effective September 6, it received approval from the Federal Trade Commission and has completed the sale of its UV Curing subsidiary to Fairey Group Plc.
Fusion said the transaction is a sale of assets and an assumption of specified liabilities of the Fusion UV Curing business as well as the sale of stock in some related subsidiaries.
Fusion said it received $121 million in cash which, after costs and full tax provision, will result in a one-time gain of about $54 million or about $6.60 per share in the third quarter.
